items.period: Shang period script style, traditionally dated broadly to the late second millennium BCE; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 門 in a Shang oracle-bone script style, illustrating the early gate graph discussed in paleographic accounts.
items.alt: Black line drawing of an early 門 form on a plain background; pixel-level details have not been checked in this research pass.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the character and script style, names source collections, and provides an original image link with CC0 terms. It can illustrate the early graph while being explicitly labeled as a redraw.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on Commons; public-domain dedication
